answers.core: It is part of the core `NavigationServer` functionality.
answers.workaround:
Considered:

- Waiting 50 frames. Almost guaranteed to be ready.
    - Unclear code, and wasteful.
    - Non-deterministic
- Querying for a path every frame until a non-zero count result is returned
    - Does not work for subsequent region generations
- Create a new navMap for each scene, with a single region per map and use the "Query for path every frame" method
    - This one could work, but poses limitations on the intended usage of `NavigationServer` (i.e. cannot reasonably use more than a single `NavigationRegion` per navMap, must pass navMap id around to any users of the `NavigationRegion` (agents))
